response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development, performance optimization, and system architecture, with a strong background in low-latency applications and hardware-software co-design. However, his experience is primarily in web, mobile, and embedded systems, with no direct evidence of work on AI accelerators, SoC/IP modeling, or deep-learning workload optimization. His educational background and current role do not align closely with the specialized hardware requirements of the Principal Performance Architect position.
strengths: Strong expertise in performance optimization and system architecture design
Experience with low-latency applications and hardware-software co-design
Proven track record in developing scalable and testable software projects
concerns: Lacks direct experience with AI accelerators or SoC/IP modeling
No demonstrated background in deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture
Educational path (Bachelor's in CS) does not meet the preferred PhD or extensive industry experience requirement
